audience: churches, schools and small organizations who send text and voice broadcasts with DialMyCalls

useCases.title: Check your credits and recent broadcasts
useCases.text: The AI reads the credits left on the account and lists recent text and call broadcasts with recipients, credit cost and send time.

useCases.title: See who received a broadcast and the result
useCases.text: The AI lists the recipients of a text broadcast with delivery status, or of a call broadcast with the result per number, such as answered or voicemail.

useCases.title: Read incoming texts and do-not-contact numbers
useCases.text: The AI lists text messages people sent to your numbers and the numbers on your do-not-contact lists, so you know who replied or opted out.

useCases.title: Add or update contacts, or create a group
useCases.text: The AI lists the contacts in a group, adds a contact with a phone number, updates one, or creates an empty group. Nothing is sent to the contact.

useCases.title: Preview, send, schedule or cancel a text broadcast
useCases.text: The AI prepares a text to a group with an active keyword and shows a preview first. After you approve, it sends or schedules the text, which spends credits. A scheduled text can be cancelled.

useCases.title: Create a voice recording and send a call broadcast
useCases.text: The AI turns text into a voice recording, then sends or schedules a call with an approved caller ID after you approve. It spends credits.
